subtitle: A chapter and an appendix revised without renumbering
description: A fixture for lettered paragraph tags. A revision adds a paragraph after [1-2] as [1-2a], then [1-2b], and after [A1-1] as [A1-1a], so no existing tag moves and no citation needs repointing.

run.sh checks all three checkers: check-book.sh accepts the sequence and reports it, and fails three broken ones; check-references.sh resolves citations of lettered tags and fails a missing one; check-provenance.sh resolves a mark that cites one.
